title: standalone advance_state bypasses i64 overflow guard
description: advance_state_counter_in_tx() has an overflow guard at i64::MAX-1. The three standalone variants ContactStore::advance_state(), ChatStore::advance_state(), MessageStore::advance_state_counter() skip this guard. Called from kithd/src/events.rs in production. At i64::MAX SQLite would silently wrap to i64::MIN. Purely defense-in-depth (impossible in practice), but creates an inconsistent invariant. Fix: route standalone advance_state methods through advance_state_counter_in_tx().
